data.name: 末日传奇
data.detailed_description:
末日传奇 is a post-apocalyptic role-playing game. Seven years after the Great Collapse, ash-gray mist has swallowed the old world, and civilization is being reshaped by ruins, mutants, and conflicts between different factions. You play as an awakened survivor who has lost their memory, exploring a dangerous wasteland and making key choices that reveal the truth behind the fall of the world.

In the game, you can defeat monsters, explore dangerous areas, and encounter events to obtain items and equipment that improve your abilities. As your adventure progresses, you can strengthen and upgrade your gear, improve your character, and unlock stronger ways to fight and survive. Each journey may bring new resources, challenges, and opportunities for growth.

The game features branching storylines, random encounters, and multiple endings. Your choices will affect which faction you join, how the story develops, and which ending you reach. You may follow the path of order, coexistence, or chaos as you search for your own way to survive in a changing wasteland.

Key Features:

- Post-apocalyptic role-playing gameplay

- Monster battles, exploration, and resource gathering

- Item and equipment drops

- Equipment upgrades and character progression

- Three faction-based story routes

- Random encounters and multiple endings

- Replayable wasteland adventure

In a world covered by ash-gray mist, every choice may change your fate.
